name: Psychics And Witchcraft
overview: Scripture sternly forbids involvement with psychics, witches, and all forms of witchcraft, commanding that those who practice such things not be allowed to live (Exodus 22:18; Leviticus 20:27). Believers are warned not to seek out familiar spirits or wizards, as doing so defiles and provokes God's judgment, resulting in severe consequences including being cut off from the community (Leviticus 19:31; 20:6). The use of divination, enchantments, and observing times is explicitly prohibited, emphasizing God's call for His people to remain separate from occult practices and wholly dependent on Him (Leviticus 19:26; Deuteronomy 18:10).
